data.body: Implemented the live-set marker: the full scan now ALWAYS writes .rebar/enrich-gate.json, adding a 'live' field (ids with an enqueued, not-DONE entry). A TTL-fresh marker that cannot prove quiet scopes the walk to reducing only the live entries (O(backlog), not O(store)); scoped probes never rewrite the marker so the TTL still counts from the last FULL walk. The scan loop incl. the f400 (not_before_ns, id) service-order sort is extracted into one _scan_pending helper shared by both paths; _gate_marker_says_quiet was inlined into pending_enrichment and deleted (no other callers, grep-confirmed). Honesty rules preserved: marker only asserts absence (whole-store or outside-live-set); every append still clears it; wrong-typed live distrusts the whole marker. 6 new tests (RED-first: standing-backlog syscall pin at store sizes 4/40, new-enqueue visibility, TTL non-refresh, live-field validation, soak-expiry via scoped path, service-order parity); all 34 queue tests + 237 enrich/drain/overlap tests pass; make lint, typecheck, complexity ratchet (new=0 increased=0) green. queue.py at 492 LOC.
